title: Affine bit moment
statement: Let $s,b\in\bbr$ with $|b|<1$. The uniform expectation over the one-dimensional Boolean cube satisfies $\E\bigl[|1+b\sigma(x_1)|^s\bigr]=\bigl((1+b)^s+(1-b)^s\bigr)/2$.
replaced: Let $s,b\in\bbr$ with $|b|<1$, uniform one-bit expectation satisfies $\E_{t\in\{0,1\}}|1+b(-1)^t|^s=((1+b)^s+(1-b)^s)/2$.
